title: Act No. 431/2002 Z. z. on Accounting (zákon o účtovníctve)
citation: Act No. 431/2002 Z. z. on Accounting, as amended; § 20 (annual report, non-financial information) and §§ 20c to 20g (sustainability reporting)
evidence: § 41: "Tento zákon nadobúda účinnosť 1. januára 2003 okrem § 3 ods. 4 až 7, ktoré nadobúdajú účinnosť 1. januára 2004." Vyhlásené znenie opened at https://static.slov-lex.sk/static/SK/ZZ/2002/431/vyhlasene_znenie.print.html on 2026-11-02; the Zbierka page gives Dátum vyhlásenia 01.08.2002.
notes: Whole act stored in every version, not a cut of § 20: the act is one text and the sections move between versions. The non-financial information provisions (§ 20 ods. 9 to 15, public-interest entities above 500 employees) first appear in the 2017-01-01 časová verzia; sustainability reporting (§§ 20c and 20g) appears in the 2024-06-01 version, after Act 105/2024 (sk-act-105-2024, in force 2024-06-01). Later versions follow the history page. Records stored on 2026-11-02: 44 Slovak (sk) records, the vyhlásené znenie (adopted, SK-SLOVLEX-ADOPTED) and 43 časové verzie (consolidated, SK-SLOVLEX-CONSOLIDATED), each tag-stripped from the print HTML.
